Passed on the fake backend by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/linden713__humanoid_amp --backend fake` (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json has authored_by kind model with model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 and run_id wD-038, reviewed_by null; no hardware run and no human review is claimed. Scope: this package models one environment class, humanoid_amp.humanoid_amp_env:HumanoidAmpEnv, through the dance registration Isaac-Humanoid-AMP-Dance-Direct-v0. The other card entry symbol (humanoid_amp.g1_amp_env:G1AmpEnv), the Run/Walk task ids and the two G1 task ids are other configurations/devices and are not covered (facts.md 'Scope'). Mock path: task.mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the upstream simulator is Isaac Sim 5.0/Isaac Lab 2.2 with a GPU (README.md:6-7) and was not available where the gate runs; the fake backend is therefore the package's pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py), not a recording and not the upstream environment, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fake implements only the Gymnasium surface (action_space, observation_space, reset, step, close) with the configured 28 action and 81 observation dimensions; it models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, gravity, sensors or noise, and the fidelity gaps and fake docstring list every difference. Its initial values, increments and observation constants are test data, each marked '# placeholder', and none was copied into a Fact, a Limit or the reference. Warnings, all expected or explained: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived ticks, action.values and two seed inputs; G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close, which the Gymnasium interface inherits from DirectRLEnv outside the clone; and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the action Box is unbounded and the clone states the action count 28 but no bounds (humanoid_amp_env_cfg.py:33), so no limit is invented. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
